name: v37_cfo_actual_consensus_delivery
hypothesis: Operating cash-flow delivery above analyst consensus may identify firms whose cash conversion is better than expected, without using historical CFO/quality or sales surprise.
notes: Annual CFO actual/consensus delivery; avoids cashflow_op/assets, close/open, sales, EPS, option, and news novelty.

name: v37_fcf_actual_consensus_delivery
hypothesis: Free-cash-flow actuals above annual consensus may capture cash profitability delivery through a different route than FCF/EV yield.
notes: Annual FCF delivery; compare with RRpm5LEo/FCF-yield legacy but no valuation denominator.

name: v37_capex_underspend_delivery
hypothesis: Lower actual capex versus consensus may capture disciplined investment and cash preservation distinct from historical capex/assets.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_capex_value / anl4_fs_detail_estimate_1qf_v4_nd_capex_mean, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_capex_value / anl4_fs_detail_estimate_1qf_v4_nd_capex_mean, 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Capex actual vs estimate underspend; strict comparison to MPp7RPxn capex/CFO ACTIVE.

name: v37_netdebt_below_consensus
hypothesis: Actual net debt below analyst consensus may signal balance-sheet improvement or cleaner cash generation, distinct from credit-capacity/news fields.
notes: Net-debt delivery without credit facility or credit-rating news.

name: v37_total_assets_disciplined_delivery
hypothesis: Lower actual total assets versus consensus can proxy conservative asset growth and investment discipline, a balance-sheet version of the investment factor.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_totassets_value / anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_totassets_mean, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_totassets_value / anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_totassets_mean, 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Asset discipline delivery; no sales/CFO/quality anchor.

name: v37_shareholder_equity_delivery
hypothesis: Shareholders' equity actuals above consensus may capture balance-sheet book-value delivery without using profitability or payout fields.
notes: Shareholder-equity actual vs consensus; low-alphaCount but watch coverage/sub-universe.

name: v37_cfo_guidance_midpoint
hypothesis: Management's operating-cash-flow guidance midpoint above consensus may be an underused forward cash-conversion signal.
notes: CFO guidance vs consensus; guidance history has been weak, so this is a narrow probe.

name: v37_fcf_guidance_midpoint
hypothesis: Free-cash-flow guidance midpoint above consensus may capture management confidence in cash generation without valuation or sales fields.
notes: FCF guidance vs consensus; no sales/EPS/option/news.
